description: This file defines the SupplierScorecard class and related functions for managing supplier scorecards, including validation, score calculation, standings updates, and scorecard period management within an ERP system.

classes.name: SupplierScorecard
classes.description: Represents a supplier scorecard document with methods for validation, score calculation, and updating standings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates standings, criteria weights, calculates total score, and updates the supplier standing.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Triggers scorecard recalculation and saves the document if score is positive.

methods.name: validate_standings
methods.description: Checks for overlapping standings and score coverage from 0 to 100.

methods.name: calculate_total_score
methods.description: Calculates total supplier score based on associated scorecard periods.

methods.name: update_standing
methods.description: Updates the supplier's standing and related info based on the score.
